recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core source work is needed unless a future work group decision changes the semantics of ContactPoint.system=url.
issue_request: FHIR-14015 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 request to update the ContactPointSystem URL code definition so it would not imply only personal contacts and would also cover institutional contacts such as an organization's web site. Ewout Kramer's caveat clarified that the organization's own web site belongs in Organization.telecom rather than Organization.contact.telecom.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 14475, now git commit 572d2ff11aad7b27cb6536ceb5b4914c47bf9638, which changed source/datatypes/contactpoint.xml for contact-point-system/url from personal-only wording to institutional-or-personal wording with web sites included. The current source still contains that wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively routes datatypes into the build, and source/datatypes/contactpoint.xml contains the contact-point-system worksheet, making it the relevant current source. Later FHIR-36033 was Resolved - No Change and quoted the current URL definition as broad enough to cover messenger URLs, so it supports leaving the FHIR-14015 wording unchanged. Confluence and Zulip searches found no directly relevant conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no source edit is needed: the active ContactPointSystem URL definition already satisfies the institutional-contact clarification requested by FHIR-14015.

related_jiras.note: A later Resolved - No Change request to add a messenger ContactPointSystem code quoted the current URL definition and treated it as already broad enough for URL-based contacts.
